freeze_rule: The retrospective corpus may grow in G0 batches until step A (adaptive saturation) begins. From the first A commit it is immutable: no item added, edited or removed; a wrong item is retracted by a new record. Only the prospective holdout grows afterwards.

reporting_rule.rule: Any benchmark report gives results per stratum (evaluation_role x originated_by x contamination level, with counts) and never one pooled score. regression_guard items measure non-reversion only, never detection; judgment_calibration items measure agreement with unvalidated v1 or source judgments, never accuracy; the prospective holdout is reported separately from the retrospective corpus.
